measurement.position_age_definition: first fetch request time minus vehicle timestamp

prediction_error.definition: predicted minus inferred time; arrival, or departure at a trip's first stop

jitter.definition: distance from the dwell's median position; speed under 0.5 m/s, within 150 m of a first or last stop, at least 3 reports

schedule.note: Scheduled trips come from the Passio calendar, which has no holiday exceptions. On a day Island Transit lists as having no service, service_expected is false and the day is left out of figures that pool several days.
